blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Earthquake-resistant construction ensures building safety and structural integrity during seismic activity.
Proper land-use planning minimizes risk by restricting high-density development in active seismic zones.
Early warning systems provide vital lead time to execute emergency safety procedures before major shaking occurs.
Public awareness initiatives and routine drills build community preparedness and reduce panic during disasters.
Seismic disaster management encompasses both structural measures (earthquake-resistant construction) and non-structural measures (land-use planning, early warning, and drills).
Land-use planning and building codes are frequently cited in competitive exam questions as primary pre-disaster mitigation strategies.
